The class is built on the compiler builtins ``__builtin_pointer_tag_insert``, ``_get`` and ``_strip``: a tagged pointer is the pointer plus the tag as a byte offset at run time; in constant expressions the tag is a separate field of the pointer value (the object must be aligned to at least 2^bits bytes) and the compiler diagnoses every use of a tagged pointer other than copying, comparing for equality and the builtins, as the invalid pointer value it is. ``__cpp_lib_pointer_tag_pair`` 202606L in C++29 mode only.
